children: China's central bank injected fresh cash through overnight reverse repurchase agreements on Monday, as its borrowing cost officially takes on the role of key policy rate.
The People's Bank of China (PBOC) said on Monday that it injected 541 billion yuan ($81.31 billion) through overnight reverse repurchase agreements at 1.25%, according to an online statement.
The central bank said last Friday that it would start to conduct overnight reverse repos every day and switch the seven-day operations to multiple rates from a single fixed one.
